# Q4. How many control and how many disease?

```{r}
all_gsm_attr_ctrl <- all_gsm_attr[grepl("control|normal|healthy|wild|ctrl|Ctrl|WT|Neg|neg", all_gsm_attr$source_name_ch1) | grepl("control|normal|healthy|wild|ctrl|Ctrl|WT|Neg|neg", all_gsm_attr$characteristics_ch1), ]

all_gsm_attr_disease <- all_gsm_attr[grepl("tumo?r|cancer|patient|disease|mutant|treated|stim|mut|KO|KD|Pos|pos", all_gsm_attr$source_name_ch1) | grepl("tumo?r|cancer|patient|disease|mutant|treated|stim|mut|KO|KD|Pos|pos", all_gsm_attr$characteristics_ch1), ]
table(all_gsm_attr_ctrl$series_id)
table(all_gsm_attr_disease$series_id)
table(all_gsm_attr$source_name_ch1[all_gsm_attr$series_id == "GSE186458"])
```

GSE162183: 3 control => 3 disease (since there are 6 total samples, but nothing matches my disease query)

GSE166530: 5 control, 36 disease

GSE186458: No case-control, but has several tissue sources as tabulated above.

GSE201427: 5 control, 3 treatment (since there are 8 total samples, but nothing matches my treatment query)
